title: Holding More Than One Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
A patient may hold at most **2** Self-Pay Visit Packages that are pending payment, active or frozen at the same time. The limit exists so that a new package can be bought ahead of the current one running out.

**Which packages count toward the limit**

| Package status on the patient's records | Counts toward the limit of 2 |
|---|---|
| Pending payment | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Frozen | Yes |
| Exhausted | No |
| Expired | No |
| Cancelled | No |

**Hypothetical illustrations**

- A patient holds one active package and one frozen package: both count, so the patient already holds the 2 packages the limit allows, and a further purchase would take the patient to 3.
- A patient holds one active package and one exhausted package: only the active package counts, so the patient holds 1 of the 2 packages the limit allows.
- A patient holds one package pending payment and nothing else: it counts, and the patient holds 1 of the 2.
